   Build a complete invoicing system over a series of incremental requests. The system progressed from basic invoice creation through payments, discounts, VAT, customer tiers, date handling, payment terms, vouchers, and finally customer statements.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Result pattern: ok(value) and fail(code) for error handling
   - Money handling: integer cents with roundCents() for rounding
   - Invoice lifecycle: draft → issued → partially_paid → paid
   - Discount application: line-level percentage discounts, tier-based defaults
   - VAT calculation: per-line VAT on amount after discount, sum of rounded line VATs
   - Date handling: YYYY-MM-DD strings, UTC-based arithmetic
   - Payment terms: NET14, NET30, EOM (end of month)
   - Vouchers: fixed-amount, post-VAT reduction, draft invoices only
   - Non-mutation principle: all functions return new objects preserving input

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - src/invoices.js
     - Core invoice module containing: createInvoice, lineTotal, invoiceTotals, addLine, removeLine, issueInvoice, applyVoucher
     - createInvoice: validates customer, date, lines; applies tier discount when discountPercent not provided; stores normalized customerId, terms, dueDate
     - invoiceTotals: computes subtotal, discount, vat, voucher, total; returns { subtotal, discount, vat, voucher, total } where total = subtotal - discount + vat - voucher (clamped at 0)
     - applyVoucher: fixed-amount vouchers on draft invoices only, one per invoice
   
   - src/errors.js
     - Error codes added: AMOUNT_INVALID, CUSTOMER_INVALID, CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND, DATE_INVALID, DISCOUNT_INVALID, INVALID_INVOICE, INVALID_LINE, LINE_NOT_FOUND, NOT_DRAFT, NOT_ISSUED, NO_LINES, OVERPAYMENT, QTY_INVALID, TERMS_INVALID, UNKNOWN_SKU, VOUCHER_EXISTS
   
   - src/customers.js
     - Added normalizeId(id): trims whitespace, converts to uppercase
     - Added TIER_DISCOUNTS: { gold: 5, silver: 2.5, standard: 0 }
     - Updated getCustomer to normalize input ID
   
   - src/catalogue.js
     - Products have: sku, name, unitPrice (cents), vatRate (21, 9, or 0)
   
   - src/money.js
     - roundCents(x): banker's rounding (half to even)
     - formatEuros(cents): formats for display with € and thousands separators
   
   - src/numbering.js
     - nextInvoiceNumber(existingNumbers, issueDate): generates INV-YYYY-NNNN format, counter per year starting at 0001
   
   - src/dates.js
     - isValidDate(text): validates YYYY-MM-DD format and real dates
     - addDays(date, n): adds days in UTC
     - daysBetween(a, b): whole days between dates (b - a)
   
   - src/payments.js
     - recordPayment(invoice, { amount, date }): records payment on issued/partially_paid invoices, updates status
     - balanceDue(invoice): returns total minus sum of payments
   
   - src/render.js
     - renderInvoiceText(invoice): plain-text invoice with DRAFT/number, customer name, line items, VAT line, total
   
   - src/statements.js
     - statement(customerId, invoices, asOf): returns { customerId, invoices, totalDue }
     - Filters for issued/partially_paid invoices with issueDate ≤ asOf
     - Each invoice: { number, issueDate, dueDate, total, due }
     - Sorted by issueDate
